channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: 'Quarteto fantástico' do Flamengo está de volta? Relembre quem eram os rubro-negros campeões de 1958 pelo Brasil
item.description: Flamengo has four players called up for the World Cup for the first time in 68 years, matching its 1958 feat. Danilo, Alex Sandro, Léo Pereira and Lucas Paquetá are in Brazil's final squad for the 2026 World Cup, just like Zagallo, Dida, Joel and Moacir were in 1958. The club may also have up to five additional players representing other South American nations.

item.title: O que pensam aliados de Flávio e Caiado sobre Joaquim Barbosa na disputa ao Planalto
item.description: Allies of Flávio Bolsonaro and Ronaldo Caiado believe Joaquim Barbosa has lost the timing to be competitive in the 2026 presidential race, having been absent from public life for years. They argue he no longer embodies either the 'justiceiro' image — now associated with Alexandre de Moraes — or the 'anti-PT magistrate' figure, which has been taken over by Sergio Moro among Bolsonaro voters.

item.title: Flávio “irmão do Vorcaro” Bolsonaro e as próximas pesquisas
item.description: The author criticizes the tendency of Brazilian voters to repeat past mistakes by supporting inefficient politicians, using Flávio Bolsonaro — nicknamed 'brother of Vorcaro' — as an example. Despite a lack of significant achievements, voters remain loyal to figures tied to Bolsonarism. The post was originally published on O Antagonista.

item.title: Flávio cai 6 pontos no 2º turno após mensagens a Vorcaro, indica AtlasIntel
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) dropped six percentage points in voter intention for a potential runoff against Lula (PT), according to an AtlasIntel/Bloomberg survey released Tuesday, the 19th. The decline followed the leak of messages sent by the senator to banker Daniel Vorcaro, former owner of Master. Lula now leads with 48.9%, compared to 41.8% for the PL candidate.

item.title: Fora da Copa, Bento desabafa nas redes após perder vaga para Weverton: 'As coisas não acabam por aqui'
item.description: Goalkeeper Bento expressed disappointment on social media after being left out of Brazil's final squad for the 2026 FIFA World Cup, thanking supporters and stating 'things don't end here'. Goalkeeping coach Taffarel clarified that Weverton was selected over Bento due to experience, not a recent error, citing Alisson and Ederson's injuries and emphasizing Weverton's extensive international background with over 50 caps and 10 appearances for Brazil.

item.title: AtlasIntel: áudio com Vorcaro impacta eleitor e Flávio perde fôlego na disputa com Lula
item.description: The leak of an audio in which Senator Flávio Bolsonaro demands money from banker Daniel Vorcaro was known by 95.6% of voters and negatively impacted his campaign, reducing his support by over five points. According to the AtlasIntel/Bloomberg poll, Lula leads with 47.0% against Flávio’s 34.3% in the first round, a nearly 13-point advantage. In a potential runoff, Lula maintains over a seven-point lead, while Renan Santos (Missão) gained third place with 6.9% without offsetting Flávio’s losses.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro cai 5 pontos em pesquisa após divulgação de troca de mensagens com Vorcaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro dropped over five points in the AtlasIntel/Bloomberg poll, falling from 39.7% to 34.3% after messages with Daniel Vorcaro were disclosed, while Lula rose to 47%. Renan Santos and Romeu Zema gained from the bolsonarist decline, and the scenario without Flávio shows no candidate can inherit his base, strengthening Lula’s position in a potential runoff.

item.title: Atlas: 51,7% veem evidências de envolvimento de Flávio Bolsonaro com escândalo do Master após áudio
item.description: Atlas/Bloomberg poll shows 51.7% of Brazilian voters who became aware of the audio exchanges between Flávio Bolsonaro and banker Daniel Vorcaro believe there is evidence of the senator’s involvement in the Banco Master scandal. Meanwhile, 33.3% argue the conversations were legitimate efforts to secure funding for the film 'Dark Horse', a tribute to Jair Bolsonaro. The fallout is severe: 47.1% of respondents say they would no longer vote for Flávio Bolsonaro for president following the revelations.

item.title: Conselho de Ética vota nova suspensão de Pollon; governistas veem chance de aprovar
item.description: The House Ethics Committee is set to vote on Tuesday, the 19th, on a report by Deputy Ricardo Maia (MDB-BA) recommending the procedural validity of disciplinary proceedings against Marcos Pollon (PL-MS) for defamatory statements against the House presidency made in August 2025. Government allies see the vote as an opportunity to approve Pollon’s suspension, following prior disciplinary actions against him in the same committee.

item.title: João Pedro é eleito melhor jogador do Chelsea na temporada horas depois de ficar fora de convocação para Copa do Mundo
item.description: João Pedro was named Chelsea's Player of the Season, receiving over 60% of fan votes, just hours after being left out of Brazil's 2026 World Cup squad. The forward had an outstanding debut season with 20 goals and five assists in 49 appearances, including key performances in the Club World Cup and a hat-trick against Aston Villa.

item.title: Rodinei reage após convocação de Ancelotti e manda recado nas redes: ‘Ainda sou brasileiro’
item.description: Right-back Rodinei, currently playing for Olympiacos, responded to his omission from Brazil's 2026 World Cup squad by Carlo Ancelotti with a social media post stating that, although not selected, he will continue giving his best in Greece and reminded everyone: 'I am still Brazilian'.

item.title: Galípolo vai ao Senado para prestar esclarecimentos sobre transações envolvendo o Master e o BRB
item.description: Central Bank President Gabriel Galípolo appears before the Senate's Economic Affairs Committee to explain financial operations involving Banco Master, amid pressure to install a parliamentary inquiry (CPI) into the bank. The hearing follows leaked audio in which Senator Flávio Bolsonaro requested R$134 million from the bank's owner to finance a biopic of former President Jair Bolsonaro. Galípolo is expected to criticize Roberto Campos Neto's management during the Bolsonaro administration.

item.title: Danilo pode não atuar mais pelo Botafogo após convocação para a Copa pela seleção
item.description: Danilo, called up for the World Cup, asked not to play for Botafogo against Corinthians to avoid injury and prevent a transfer block to another Brazilian club in 2026. His availability for upcoming matches in the Sudamericana and Brasileirão is uncertain, with club management dissatisfied and his representatives unhappy over delayed payments. Although his sale after the tournament is nearly certain, coach Franclim Carvalho may already be planning a team without him, especially after Huguinho impressed as a replacement.

item.title: As eleições brasileiras e as perspectivas para o BRICS+
item.description: The 2026 Brazilian elections are affecting Brazil's engagement in BRICS+, with the Lula government maintaining only a formally active posture amid domestic political uncertainty and congressional opposition. Ex-president Jair Bolsonaro's explicit statements that he would withdraw Brazil from the bloc if returned to power heighten strategic uncertainty about the continuity of Brazilian participation. Although Brazil continues to perform symbolic roles — such as advocating for expansion and hosting preparatory meetings — progress toward deeper integration, including local currency payments and joint industrial policies, has significantly slowed.

item.title: Os dois objetivos e os dois abacaxis que Flávio Bolsonaro tem pela frente nesta semana
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro faces two strategic objectives and at least two significant challenges (pineapples to peel) this week, according to an exclusive subscriber-only article. The content does not disclose specific details, indicating that full access requires registration and login on the publication’s website.

item.title: Datafolha: 59% dos brasileiros dizem não ter sabido da rejeição de indicado de Lula ao STF pelo Senado
item.description: A Datafolha poll reveals that 59% of Brazilians were unaware of the Senate's rejection of Lula's Supreme Court nominee, equivalent to 6 in 10 respondents. Among the 41% who were informed, 53% believe the government emerged weaker from the defeat, while only 7% see it as stronger. The survey interviewed 2,004 people between March 12 and 13, with a margin of error of two percentage points.

item.title: Oposição planeja estratégia eleitoral em 4 Estados do Nordeste e PT pode perder hegemonia
item.description: The opposition plans to exploit public security as the PT's main weakness in four Northeastern states (Ceará, Rio Grande do Norte, Piauí, and Bahia), where homicide rates exceed the national average. Bahia and Ceará rank among the worst in the country, with Fortaleza and Salvador among the most violent capitals. Former mayor ACM Neto (União Brasil) leads the criticism against PT governor Jerônimo Rodrigues in Bahia, with a poll showing a technical tie (41% to 37%).

item.title: Cotada para vice diz a Flávio Bolsonaro não ser ‘extremista’: ‘Converso do PT ao PL’
item.description: Deputy Simone Marquetto (PP-SP), tipped as a vice-presidential candidate on Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL-RJ) ticket, said she is not an extremist lawmaker and maintains dialogue with politicians from the PT to the PL, emphasizing her conciliatory, center-right profile. She highlighted her social work, ties to the Catholic Church, and stated she will not run for re-election, claiming an executive profile. The meeting took place during a tense moment for Flávio Bolsonaro, following leaked conversations in which he asked banker Daniel Vorcaro for money for the film Dark Horse.

item.title: Torcida do Brasil 'enlouqueceu' com 'conto de fadas' de Neymar, diz jornal
item.description: Neymar's call-up for the 2026 World Cup sparked widespread joy among Brazilian fans, with international media describing it as a 'fairy tale'. The Santos striker, aged 34 and returning after over two years away from the national team, was celebrated as an emotional comeback despite his injury-plagued recent career. The notable omission of Chelsea's João Pedro was highlighted, while Vinícius Júnior and Raphinha were also emphasized in the selections.

item.title: Aliados de Lula se dividem sobre estratégia de insistir na indicação de Messias para o STF
item.description: Allies of President Lula are divided over whether to persist with the nomination of Jorge Messias to the Supreme Federal Court (STF). The more combative faction argues the government should not yield to Senate President Davi Alcolumbre’s demands, while pragmatists believe the nomination should be delayed for a more opportune moment. The exclusive report reveals internal rifts within Lula’s coalition over the STF appointment strategy.

item.title: Dino diz ter sido ameaçado por funcionária de companhia aérea
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Flávio Dino reported being threatened with death by an airline employee who, upon seeing his name on a boarding pass, said it would be "better to kill than to insult" him. He linked the incident to rising electoral tensions and urged companies to promote civic education to prevent violence against public officials. STF President Edson Fachin condemned the threat, emphasizing that ideological differences must not justify hatred, violence, or personal attacks, and called for serenity and democratic commitment in Brazil.

item.title: Sinais de freio em ano eleitoral
item.description: In March, Brazil's economy contracted by 0.7% according to the Central Bank's Economic Activity Index, although the first quarter still showed 1.3% growth due to strong agribusiness performance early in the year. However, outlook for the rest of 2026 is concerning, with rising production costs and falling international prices for agricultural commodities. The market raised its year-end Selic rate projection in the Focus survey, signaling expectations for a more prolonged monetary tightening cycle.

item.title: Disputa inglória
item.description: The success of Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential candidacy now depends on external factors, particularly revelations from Federal Police investigations and the plea bargain of former banker Daniel Vorcaro. His credibility has been damaged by concealing his relationship with Vorcaro, raising suspicions about what else he might be hiding. The article suggests that new scandals could emerge and jeopardize his electoral viability.

item.title: Lula lança programa para motoristas de apps ao custo de R$ 30 bi
item.description: President Lula launches the Move Aplicativos program, allocating up to R$ 30 billion from the National Treasury to finance vehicles up to R$ 150,000 for app drivers and taxi drivers, with interest rates below the Selic (12.55% annually for app drivers, 11.40% for taxi drivers). The program requires at least 100 rides in the last 12 months, though unions are negotiating a higher threshold to prevent opportunistic sign-ups after the announcement. Anfavea urges excluding or limiting imported vehicles to prioritize domestic industry, while the government frames the initiative as a response to pent-up demand for vehicles following the failure to pass app-based labor regulation in Congress.

item.title: Datafolha: Para 51% dos brasileiros é muito importante uma mulher no STF, pessoa negra e religioso somam 46% cada
item.description: The Datafolha poll shows 51% of Brazilians consider it very important to appoint a woman to the STF, with 46% saying the same for Black and religious individuals. Among Lula’s 2026 voters, these figures rise to 64% (woman) and 60% (Black), indicating strong support for diversity criteria in his base. The rejection of Lula’s nominee, Jorge Messias, was unknown to 59% of Brazilians, and among those aware, 53% believe it weakened the government.

item.title: Mais do que Neymar: colunistas do GLOBO mostram o que lista de Ancelotti revela sobre seleção da Copa
item.description: Carlo Ancelotti's World Cup squad selection for Brazil sparked debate among GLOBO columnists, emphasizing Neymar's inclusion as a response to external pressure and the omissions of Andrey and João Pedro as missed opportunities for youth development. The list reflects concessions to star power, defensive uncertainties, and a prioritization of the present over future growth, drawing criticism for lacking long-term vision.

item.title: Datafolha: em cada 10 brasileiros, 6 não souberam que indicado de Lula ao STF foi rejeitado pelo Senado
item.description: A Datafolha poll shows that 59% of Brazilians were unaware of the Senate's rejection of Jorge Messias' nomination to the STF, despite it being a historic government defeat. Among the 41% who knew, 53% believe the government was weakened, 7% say it was strengthened, and 36% see no impact. Lack of awareness is similar among evangelicals (59%) and higher among Lula voters (61%) and those planning to cast blank, null, or no vote (72%).

item.title: Direita enfrenta longo deserto
item.description: The text reflects on the current state of the Brazilian right, referencing Flávio Bolsonaro's 'astral hell week' as a period of turmoil for the Bolsonaro family. The author nostalgically compares it to Brigadeiro Eduardo Gomes, noting how political discourse has changed since the first elections they followed. The content is subscriber-only, with a call to access the full article via registration.

item.title: Valor pedido por Flávio Bolsonaro a Vorcaro equivale a 11% do total investido pelo governo do Rio no Banco Master
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro requested R$134 million from banker Daniel Vorcaro to finance a film about Jair Bolsonaro, an amount equivalent to 11% of the R$1.2 billion invested by the Rio de Janeiro state government in Banco Master between 2023 and 2024 via Rioprevidência and Cedae. These investments, made under Cláudio Castro’s (PL) administration, were deemed high-risk due to lack of FGC coverage and long-term nature. Despite the temporal correlation, Flávio Bolsonaro denies any connection between the film funding request and the public investments in the bank.

item.title: Governo anuncia hoje financiamento especial de carros para taxistas e motoristas de aplicativo. Veja as condições
item.description: The Lula government launches today a credit program of up to R$ 30 billion, operated by BNDES through banks, to finance vehicles of up to R$ 150,000 for taxi and app-based drivers. The financing will have a term of up to 72 months and require proof of at least 100 rides in the last 12 months to prevent opportunistic enrollment. The funds will be recorded as a government financial expense, not affecting the primary balance target.

item.title: PF apresenta esquema de proteção para eleições presidenciais
item.description: The Federal Police presented the protection scheme for the 2026 presidential elections, featuring an operational plan with continuous risk analysis, preventive threat monitoring, and integrated action with public security, health, and traffic agencies. Coordinated by the DPP, the operation will deploy specially trained personnel and a national command center in Brasília, emphasizing technical criteria, impartiality, and the safeguarding of candidates' physical integrity and democratic process regularity.

item.title: Flávio comemora convocação de Neymar e diz que “Agora o hexa vem”
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) celebrated Neymar Jr.'s call-up for the 2026 World Cup, posting a photo with the player and stating 'now the hexa is coming'. The PL also released an AI-generated video linking Flávio to Neymar, while federal deputy Helio Lopes had formally requested the player's inclusion from the CBF in May.

item.title: Contrariado, Rebelo avalia judicializar troca de pré-candidatura no DC
item.description: Former minister Aldo Rebelo threatens to sue if the Christian Democracy party replaces his presidential pre-candidacy with that of retired Supreme Court Justice Joaquim Barbosa. Rebelo stated he would take the matter to court if the change is confirmed; otherwise, he would accept a democratic dispute at the party convention. Barbosa, the rapporteur of the Mensalão case and former STF president, was named the party’s new pre-candidate on May 16, 2026.

item.title: PT publica foto de Lula beijando taça da Copa após convocação
item.description: The PT published a photo of Lula kissing the World Cup trophy after the announcement of Brazil’s 2026 squad, which includes Neymar’s return after 31 months away. Lula had previously said he would support Neymar’s call-up if he were physically fit. Brazil has not won a World Cup since 2002, during Lula’s presidencies.

item.title: Datafolha: 6 em cada 10 não souberam que Senado rejeitou indicado de Lula ao STF
item.description: According to a Datafolha poll, 6 in 10 Brazilians were unaware that the Senate rejected Lula’s nominee to the Supreme Federal Court. This lack of awareness indicates low public visibility of the event, despite it being regarded as a historic defeat for the government. The result highlights a disconnect between significant institutional decisions and public perception.

item.title: Atrito entre Kassab e Tarcísio esvazia apoio do PSD no interior paulista
item.description: PSD mayors and deputies in São Paulo’s interior are considering not supporting Tarcísio de Freitas’ re-election campaign, despite party president Gilberto Kassab publicly endorsing the governor. The rift between Kassab and Tarcísio is creating internal tensions and weakening the PSD’s electoral base in the state.

item.title: Aliados de Flávio esperam por pesquisas para definir futuro, mas apostam em queda 'administrável'
item.description: Allies of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro say the next round of electoral polls will determine whether he maintains his presidential candidacy, currently shaken by messages exchanged with banker Daniel Vorcaro. Despite the challenges, they believe the impact is 'manageable' and that he could recover over time. The final decision will depend on the numbers that appear in the polls.

item.title: Lula cita Trump ao defender exploração de petróleo na Margem Equatorial
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva defended oil exploration in the Equatorial Margin, emphasizing environmental responsibility and national sovereignty. He cited Donald Trump as an example of how other nations might claim strategic areas, stating Brazil must occupy and explore the region to secure resources for the country's future. Petrobras has already obtained a license from Ibama to begin exploratory research in the Foz do Amazonas basin.

item.title: PL tenta associar imagem de Flávio Bolsonaro à de Neymar em dia de convocação
item.description: The Liberal Party (PL) used artificial intelligence to create a video associating the image of Flávio Bolsonaro, the party's pre-candidate for president, with that of footballer Neymar, following his call-up to the Brazilian national team for the 2026 World Cup. The PL's post stated 'Flávio is Neymar and Neymar is Flávio', sparking controversy, particularly given recent allegations that Flávio Bolsonaro demanded money from Daniel Vorcaro, former owner of Banco Master, who is under investigation for financial fraud. Neymar, who supported Bolsonaro in 2022, has been absent from the national team since 2023 and showed inconsistent performance with Santos in 2026, alongside involvement in several on-field controversies.

item.title: Bournemouth parabeniza Rayan por convocação para a Copa do Mundo: 'Que conquista'
item.description: Nineteen-year-old forward Rayan has been called up by Carlo Ancelotti for the Brazil national team for the 2026 World Cup following strong performances with Bournemouth, where he joined in January and scored five goals with two assists in 13 Premier League appearances. The English club celebrated the call-up on social media with a reference to the funk song 'Oi, boa noite!', praising the young player’s achievement, which he also celebrated online, crediting God, family, and friends for his success.

item.title: Após visitar Bolsonaro, Carlos diz que PL irá apoiar Alfredo Gaspar e Arthur Lira ao Senado em AL
item.description: Carlos Bolsonaro announced that, after visiting former President Jair Bolsonaro under house arrest, his father defined the PL’s support for Alfredo Gaspar (PL) and Arthur Lira (PP) as Senate candidates in Alagoas for the 2026 elections. The two are competing for the two open seats currently held by Renan Calheiros and Fernando Farias (both MDB), whose terms end in January 2027. Lira remains affiliated with the PP but is in talks to join the PL, while Gaspar is already the state president of the PL in Alagoas after leaving União Brasil.

item.title: A reação bolsonarista com a convocação de Neymar para Copa do Mundo de 2026
item.description: Bolsonarists celebrated Neymar's call-up for the 2026 World Cup, interpreting it as a sign that Brazil could win the hexacampionship. Figures such as Flávio Bolsonaro, Eduardo Bolsonaro, Nikolas Ferreira, and Guilherme Derrite praised the player, linking his presence to hopes of victory and using the event to mobilize political support.

item.title: Petrobras deve cuidar para não “tirar japonesinho” do pré-sal, diz Lula
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva joked during a Petrobras ceremony about the risk of over-drilling in deep waters, saying they must not 'take out a little Japanese' when drilling from Mexico, despite the antipode of Mexico being in the Indian Ocean, not Japan. He also stated that Petrobras will assist Pemex in exploring oil at depths of 2,000 to 3,000 meters, following a meeting between the two companies' presidents in late April.

item.title: 'Terminou a novela' do Neymar: como imprensa internacional repercutiu convocação da Seleção Brasileira
item.description: International press highlighted Neymar's inclusion in Brazil's 2026 World Cup squad after months of uncertainty, with Argentine outlet Olé declaring the 'novela' over his selection had ended. Spanish media like Marca emphasized that this will be Carlo Ancelotti's first World Cup as Brazil's head coach, while The New York Times noted the domestic debate over Neymar's call-up and criticized the omission of João Pedro. Despite recent scrutiny, global outlets maintained Brazil as a tournament favorite.

item.title: Lindbergh pede inclusão de Flávio e Jair Bolsonaro em inquérito que investiga Eduardo por coação nos EUA
item.description: Federal Deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) urged the Supreme Federal Court to include Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and former President Jair Bolsonaro in the investigation probing Eduardo Bolsonaro for alleged coercion in the U.S., claiming the funding of the film 'Dark Horse' may have served as a financial mechanism to support external campaigns against Brazil. He also requested precautionary measures against Flávio Bolsonaro, such as passport surrender and travel restrictions, and an expansion of the inquiry to examine financial ties with Daniel Vorcaro, former CEO of Banco Master.

item.title: STF descarta ação contra ‘espionagem’ em redes de jornalistas e parlamentares no governo Bolsonaro
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court (STF) ruled against a lawsuit filed by the Green Party alleging that the Bolsonaro government conducted espionage against journalists and legislators via social media monitoring reports produced by a private company. By a 7-4 vote, the justices determined the action did not constitute espionage and that an ADPF was not the appropriate legal mechanism, as the matter involved a concrete act better suited for a popular action. The ruling concluded a case that had been pending since 2022, with repeated delays in both virtual and in-person plenary sessions.

item.title: Lula vai a hospital em São Paulo para acompanhamento de procedimentos feitos em abril
item.description: President Lula (PT) underwent a routine check-up at the Sírio-Libanês Hospital in São Paulo to monitor medical procedures performed in April, including the removal of a skin lesion on his scalp and a wrist injection for tendonitis. According to the medical bulletin, his recovery is progressing satisfactorily with no complications, and he has resumed his normal activities, including attending a construction industry fair and launching the Move Aplicativos credit line for app-based drivers and taxi workers.

item.title: Lula faz exames em SP e evolução pós-tratamentos é satisfatória
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva underwent medical follow-up exams at the Sirio-Libanês Hospital in São Paulo on May 18, 2026, after procedures performed in April. The medical team reported his recovery is progressing satisfactorily, as expected, with no complications, and that he continues his regular activities. The procedures included scalp cauterization for actinic keratosis and an injection for right thumb tendinitis.

item.title: Lula vai ao hospital Sírio-Libanês para acompanhamento de procedimentos feitos em abril
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva visited the Sírio-Libanês Hospital in São Paulo on Monday, the 18th, for follow-up on two medical procedures performed in April. According to a hospital statement, Lula shows satisfactory progress with no complications.

item.title: Tebet tem 24%, Marina 23% e Derrite 18% na disputa ao Senado em SP
item.description: Simone Tebet (PSB) leads the Senate race in São Paulo with 24% voting intention, followed by Marina Silva (Rede) at 23% and Guilherme Derrite (PP-SP) at 18%. The results indicate a technical tie among the three candidates, given the 2.67 percentage point margin of error. Conducted by Gerp from May 11–15, 2026, the survey interviewed 1,400 people and is registered with the TSE under SP-06865/2026.
